name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

detail: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

detail: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

name: GG Jackson
detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

name: Richie Saunders

name: Kasparas Jakucionis

detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Colin Castleton
detail: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

name: Kevin Porter Jr.
detail: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

name: Anthony Black
detail: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Noah Penda
detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Dean Wade
detail: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

name: Jaylen Brown

detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Mark Williams
detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Damian Lillard

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Vit Krejci
detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Ja Morant
detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Zach LaVine
detail: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

name: Maxime Raynaud
detail: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

name: Ben Simmons
detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

name: Jayden Quaintance

name: Ja'Kobe Walter
detail: Walter won't return to Friday's game against Brooklyn due to a right quad contusion, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

name: Nate Bittle

name: RJ Barrett

name: Tristan Vukcevic

name: Jamir Watkins
